docs.title: Index
docs.text:
Who am I? I’m a DevOps engineer with several years of experience in developing and managing robust and scalable infrastructures. With a master’s degree in computer science, I’ve had the opportunity to work on innovative projects for internationally renowned companies.

My values:

Technical rigor and pursuit of excellence. Collaboration and knowledge sharing. Creativity in solving complex problems. My journey: After starting my career in Switzerland, I moved to Monaco where I currently work on strategic projects, particularly in Kubernetes, Terraform, and Cilium. My goal is to deliver cutting-edge solutions that meet the needs of modern businesses.Who am I?
